author: JDeiTwo
body:
The "spider" that I apparently used is actually sprint with the "better 
sprinting mod" which was added into minecraft in a update if you didn't 
know. The Sprinting can be hold down and you can sprint forever. It does
 look like a "spider" hack from another person's view, but in my screen I
 just sprint. So basically when I climp a tower that was seen in that 
video, I sprinted the whole thing up. Sprinting with a better sprinting 
mod that is added into vanilla mincraft isn't hacking. You'll need to 
try the spinting thing yourself so you can see it. Also I can't climp 
straight walls like the spider mob can. I hope you believe me, because 
this is just so wrong.
